[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I get a kick out of seeing[XENO:n ]
people's faces every time![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We were told that you were waiting for us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

That's right. I've been waiting a long time.[XENO:n ]
Waiting for you to accept my request.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]But first let me ask. The sword the young[XENO:n ]
man is holding. Is that the Monado?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

And the destruction of the fortress on the sword.[XENO:n ]
Was that your lot's doing?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Although unfortunately we[XENO:n ]
were unable to stop Egil.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Do you know him? He claims[XENO:n ]
to be the leader of Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
This Egil that you fought is one of our people.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]He is my son.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Actually, my request is about him as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I want you to kill Egil.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
